policy: Use the newest applicable authoritative source. Older standards remain active only where not superseded and where they define core ECG measurement/terminology.

sources.title: Fifth Universal Definition of Myocardial Infarction
sources.notes: Use for current ECG features of myocardial ischemia/infarction and the boundary that ECG alone does not establish clinical MI.

sources.title: 2025 ACC/AHA/ACEP/NAEMSP/SCAI Guideline for the Management of Patients With Acute Coronary Syndromes
sources.notes: Use for ACS workflow context; a nondiagnostic initial ECG does not exclude ACS.

sources.title: 2018 ACC/AHA/HRS Guideline on the Evaluation and Management of Patients With Bradycardia and Cardiac Conduction Delay
sources.notes: Use for AV-conduction terminology and classification boundaries.

sources.title: AHA/ACCF/HRS Recommendations for the Standardization and Interpretation of the Electrocardiogram, Part II: Electrocardiography Diagnostic Statement List
sources.notes: Legacy but still useful for standardized ECG terminology.

sources.title: AHA/ACCF/HRS Recommendations for the Standardization and Interpretation of the Electrocardiogram, Part III: Intraventricular Conduction Disturbances
sources.notes: Use for adult conduction morphology/duration framework.

sources.title: AHA/ACCF/HRS Recommendations for the Standardization and Interpretation of the Electrocardiogram, Part IV: ST Segment, T and U Waves, and QT Interval
sources.notes: Use for measurement conventions; newer disease-specific guidance supersedes disease criteria when applicable.

sources.title: AHA/ACCF/HRS Recommendations for the Standardization and Interpretation of the Electrocardiogram, Part V: Cardiac Chamber Hypertrophy
sources.notes: Electrical criteria do not equal imaging-defined anatomic hypertrophy.

sources.title: 2022 ESC Guidelines for the Management of Patients With Ventricular Arrhythmias and the Prevention of Sudden Cardiac Death
sources.notes: Use for syndrome context and ventricular-arrhythmia framework; ECG phenotype alone may be insufficient for syndrome diagnosis.

sources.title: Multi-society clinical consensus statement on pharmacological provocation testing in cardiac electrophysiology
sources.notes: Supports phenotype-level type-1 Brugada morphology and cautions around syndrome diagnosis after provocation testing.

sources.title: 2025 ESC Guidelines for the Management of Myocarditis and Pericarditis
applies_to: ECG as one component of diagnostic assessment
sources.notes: Supersedes the 2015 ESC pericardial guideline for active project guidance.

sources.title: 2021 ESC Guidelines on Cardiac Pacing and Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy
sources.notes: From an ECG alone, limit conclusions to supportable pacing/sensing/capture observations.

sources.title: 2015 ACC/AHA/HRS Guideline for the Management of Adult Patients With Supraventricular Tachycardia
sources.notes: Use for adult pre-excitation/accessory-pathway context, not standalone risk prediction from one ECG.

sources.title: AHA/ACCF/HRS Recommendations for the Standardization and Interpretation of the Electrocardiogram, Part I: Technology
sources.notes: Use for acquisition/technology conventions when not superseded by device-specific standards.

sources.title: Update to Practice Standards for Electrocardiographic Monitoring in Hospital Settings
sources.notes: Supports QT-monitoring cautions; not a substitute for 12-lead diagnostic evaluation.

sources.title: Diagnosis of ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction in the Presence of Left Bundle Branch Block With the ST-Elevation to S-Wave Ratio in a Modified Sgarbossa Rule
sources.notes: Primary derivation evidence for proportional ST/S discordance; use as a narrow supporting source, not a general guideline.

sources.title: Good Machine Learning Practice for Medical Device Development: Guiding Principles
sources.notes: Engineering alignment reference only; repository does not claim regulatory compliance.

sources.title: Transparency for Machine Learning-Enabled Medical Devices: Guiding Principles
sources.notes: Used as a transparency design reference; not a certification claim.

sources.title: TRIPOD+AI statement: updated guidance for reporting clinical prediction models that use regression or machine learning methods
sources.notes: Reporting framework; applicability depends on study design.

sources.title: PROBAST+AI: updated quality, risk of bias, and applicability assessment tool
sources.notes: Used to structure internal risk-of-bias thinking; not a formal completed PROBAST+AI assessment.

sources.title: The STARD-AI reporting guideline for diagnostic accuracy studies using artificial intelligence
sources.notes: Use if/when reporting diagnostic-accuracy studies.

sources.title: DECIDE-AI reporting guideline for early-stage clinical evaluation of AI decision support systems
sources.notes: Relevant if system progresses to live early-stage clinical decision-support evaluation.
